_說明: 和職能治療完全不同主題的範例：自閉症兒童。用來示範換題目時，只需要改 topics 的查詢句和 rubric 的判準。
intro: 自閉症兒童介入研究的新論文候選（Europe PMC，只搜標題）。**只是候選，請人讀過再決定**。
rubric: You triage papers for a literature radar on interventions for autistic children (age 0-12). KEEP randomized or quasi-experimental trials, systematic reviews, and meta-analyses that evaluate an intervention (for example parent-mediated, sensory-based, play-based, or social-skills programs) and report child outcomes such as communication, adaptive behavior, sensory processing, or participation. DROP study protocols without results, case reports, prevalence or screening-accuracy studies, genetics or imaging studies, and studies of adults only.

topics.label: 自閉症兒童：家長中介介入
topics.query: TITLE:(autism OR autistic OR ASD) AND TITLE:("parent-mediated" OR "parent-implemented" OR "caregiver-mediated" OR "parent training")

topics.label: 自閉症兒童：感覺處理與感覺介入
topics.query: TITLE:(autism OR autistic OR ASD) AND TITLE:("sensory integration" OR "sensory processing" OR "sensory-based" OR "sensory intervention") AND (randomized OR randomised OR "systematic review" OR "meta-analysis")

topics.label: 自閉症兒童：遊戲與社交技巧
topics.query: TITLE:(autism OR autistic OR ASD) AND TITLE:("play-based" OR "social skills" OR "peer-mediated" OR "pivotal response")
